description: "Use when embedding source code, using preproc mapfile, or converting Markdown with pandoc2review. Covers preproc and Markdown intake."

# Preproc and Markdown

- Embed files with `#@mapfile` / `#@maprange` and run `review-preproc`. See `doc/preproc.ja.md` (or `doc/preproc.md`).
- Markdown chapters are converted by pandoc2review via `contentdir: _refiles`. See `articles/chapters/markdown.md` for the intake setup.
- For InDesign XML output, see `doc/format_idg.ja.md`.
